title: karta hu mai tumhari sana murtaza ali
body:
karta hu mai tumhari sana murtaza ali
ho jaaye kuch mujhe bhi ata murtaza ali
<<DIVIDER>>
moula tumhare aane ki ye shaan ye weqaar
dar bangaya haram me naya murtaza ali
<<DIVIDER>>
do ungliyou ka zor dikhaya tha aap ne
qaibar ka dar bhi kaamp utha murtaza ali
<<DIVIDER>>
hijrat ki shab rasool ke bistar ne bhi kaha
aajaiye baraa e quda murtaza ali
<<DIVIDER>>
badbaqt hai wo shaqs jo din bhar me bhi na le
apni zaba'n se naam tera murtaza ali
<<DIVIDER>>
maidaan me ghadeer ke lakhou ke rubaroo
tum ko wasi nabi ne kaha murtaza ali
<<DIVIDER>>
baalee'n se meri mout bhi sun kar palat gayi
lab par mere faqat thi sada murtaza ali
<<DIVIDER>>
mai hu andheri qabr me imdaad kijiye
koi nahi tumhare siwa murtaza ali
<<DIVIDER>>
munkir nakeer karte rahe jaane kya sawaal
mera yahi jawaab raha murtaza ali
